## Study question

What study or analysis question are you trying to answer?

## Inputs

List the expected inputs, such as FHIR resources, DICOM/NIfTI files, BOA folders, cohort CSVs, labels, endpoints, or model outputs.

## Outputs

List the artifacts you need: tables, figures, FHIR bundles, manifests, model metrics, validation reports, or reviewer summaries.

## Constraints

Mention privacy, institutional, compute, dependency, or interoperability constraints.

## Data safety

Confirm that examples, screenshots, payloads, or manifests contain no PHI, secrets, private endpoint URLs, or patient-identifying DICOM/FHIR data.

- [ ] I used synthetic or de-identified data.
